summary_en: Luxshare Precision Cayman Ltd. to acquire Seed Co., Ltd. via tender offer. Tender price ¥795/share. Acquisition period 30 trading days (Aug 27 – Oct 13, 2026). Minimum acceptance threshold 5,408,800 shares (post-acquisition ownership 17.89%). No upper limit stated. Board recommends shareholders tender. Objective: delisting (non-public).
title_en: Notice of Commencement of Tender Offer for Common Shares of Seed Co., Ltd. (Securities Code: 7743) by Luxshare Precision Cayman Limited
translation_en_brief:
Luxshare Precision Cayman Limited, a foreign investment vehicle, has announced commencement of a public tender offer for all outstanding common shares of Seed Co., Ltd., a Tokyo Stock Exchange Standard Market-listed company (ticker 7743). The tender price is ¥795 per share. The offer period runs 30 trading days from Aug 27 to Oct 13, 2026.

The minimum acceptance threshold is 5,408,800 shares. Following acquisition at this floor, Luxshare's post-tender ownership would be 17.89% (calculated as specified under the Financial Instruments and Exchange Act Article 27-2). No upper limit on shares to be acquired is stated in the announcement. The stated objective is delisting (非公開化 — making the company private).

Seed's board of directors has resolved to recommend that shareholders tender their shares to the bidder. The announcement references Seed's separate public statement of board endorsement and tender recommendation released on the same date.
